title: Best Hotel Guest Messaging Software in 2026
summary: Compare five hotel guest messaging tools for 2026 on channels, phone coverage, PMS write-back, staff operations, and pricing.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform purpose-built for hospitality, serving 300+ hospitality brands in 120+ countries. Last updated September 24, 2026.*


Hotel guest messaging software should help your team answer questions during a stay, use reservation details, and keep the conversation together across channels. Conduit, Canary, HiJiffy, Akia, and HelloShift approach that work differently. Here is what to compare before choosing one. Running serviced apartments or an aparthotel instead? See our[aparthotel guest messaging software](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-ai-messaging-tools-for-aparthotels) comparison.


## What should hotels look for in guest messaging software in 2026?


Start with four requirements:


- The channels your guests use, including SMS, WhatsApp, web chat, and the property phone.
- Access to reservation details and the ability to write approved changes back to the PMS.
- Clear responsibility for requests at 2 a.m., including when and how staff are contacted.
- A way to assign and track staff tasks, either in the messaging product or a connected system.


Ask each vendor to demonstrate your PMS and the requests your team handles on a busy night. Include a request the agent cannot complete, so you can see how it asks staff for help.

## Is Conduit a hotel guest messaging tool or a phone system?


Both. We build Conduit to handle guest messages and hotel phone calls. Its phone features include VoiceAI, number porting, SMS, 24/7 or scheduled routing, static and dynamic escalation, and warm transfer, with Retell and ElevenLabs voices. For a general sales contact center, compare business phone systems against your requirements. See[Dialpad alternatives](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/dialpad-alternatives) and[Dialpad call center alternatives for hotels](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/dialpad-call-center-alternatives-hotels) .


## How do Canary and HiJiffy differ on this list?


Canary combines messaging with arrivals and payments, so it is worth comparing if you want to improve those processes together. HiJiffy focuses on hotel chat and may fit if check-in already works well. Canary does not publish rates. HiJiffy publishes plans from €99 a month. Ask both to demonstrate the PMS updates you need. See[Canary vs HiJiffy](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/canary-vs-hijiffy) and[HiJiffy pricing](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/hijiffy-pricing) .


## Where does Akia fit against Canary and Conduit?


Akia's AI Voice answers inbound calls, matches callers to reservations, and takes payment by secure link. Test that support on a live call and ask which reservation changes the agent can complete. Include Conduit if you need a shared text and voice agent with PMS write-back, or Canary if you also need check-in and payments. Read[Akia review, pricing and alternatives](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/akia-review-pricing-alternatives) .


## Should hotels pick HelloShift for messaging or for operations?


HelloShift combines guest messaging and AI on calls and chats with staff messaging, tasks, and housekeeping. Test the specific features your team needs, including how a guest request becomes a staff task. HelloShift publishes per-room pricing, from $1.25 per room per month billed annually, and names 40+ PMS integrations, including Oracle OPERA, Mews, and Cloudbeds. See[HelloShift review](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/helloshift-review-pricing-alternatives) and[HelloShift vs Canary](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/helloshift-vs-canary) if you need both messaging and staff operations.


## How should a hotel group roll out guest messaging?


Set shared brand rules first, then add each property's policies and details. Keep SMS, chat, and phone history in one guest thread. Measure how many requests are completed as well as how quickly guests receive replies.[How to deploy AI messaging across a hotel portfolio](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/how-to-deploy-ai-messaging-across-a-hotel-portfolio) covers the rollout. For a comparison focused on AI capabilities, see[best AI messaging tools for hotels](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-ai-messaging-tools-for-hotels) .


## FAQ


### What should hotels look for in guest messaging software in 2026?


Check channel coverage, reservation write-back, after-hours escalation, and staff task handling. Ask for a demo using your PMS and requests from a busy night, including one the agent cannot finish.


### Which hotel guest messaging tools belong on a 2026 shortlist?


Conduit, Canary, HiJiffy, Akia, and HelloShift are the five options compared here. Compare their messaging, phone, reservation, and staff features against the work your team needs to handle.


### Is Conduit a hotel guest messaging tool or a phone system?


It handles guest messages and hotel calls, with VoiceAI, number porting, SMS, 24/7 or scheduled routing, escalation, warm transfer, and Retell or ElevenLabs voices. It is built for hospitality; general sales teams should also compare business phone systems.


### How do Canary and HiJiffy differ on this list?


Canary combines messaging with digital check-in and payments. HiJiffy focuses on hotel chat. Canary does not publish rates. HiJiffy publishes plans from €99 a month. Test PMS write-back and phone coverage, and check how either product would work with your existing inbox.


### Where does Akia fit against Canary and Conduit?


Akia's AI Voice answers inbound calls, matches callers to reservations, and takes payment by secure link. Compare its ability to complete guest requests with Conduit's text and voice agent, and its guest-journey features with Canary's. Ask for a live reservation-change demo.


### Should hotels pick HelloShift for messaging or for operations?


Consider HelloShift if you need guest messaging alongside housekeeping, tasks, and staff communication. Test each workflow your team depends on. Ask for pricing and confirmation of your PMS integration.


### How should a hotel group roll out guest messaging?


Set shared brand rules, then add property-specific policies and details. Keep guest history together across SMS, chat, and phone, and measure completed requests. Ask the vendor to demonstrate how shared settings are reused and updated across hotels.
